name: IKI Large Grants (thematic and country priorities)

funder.name: German Federal Ministry for the Environment, Climate Action, Nature Conservation and Nuclear Safety (BMUKN)

administered_by.name: IKI Office at Zukunft - Umwelt - Gesellschaft (ZUG) gGmbH

summary: Annual ideas competition of Germany's International Climate Initiative for large multi-year projects by consortia, set around yearly thematic and country priorities in climate mitigation, adaptation, natural carbon sinks and biodiversity conservation.
reporting: Implementing organisations submit an annual interim report (technical report on results, IKI standard indicators and safeguards, plus a financial statement) by 30 April, and twice-yearly project updates.

status.quote: A new call for IKI Large Grants will be published on this website shortly.
The deadline for submitting project outlines for the IKI Large Grants ideas competition (Call) was 17 February 2026, 2 pm (CET).

deadline.quote: The deadline for submitting project outlines for the IKI Large Grants ideas competition (Call) was 17 February 2026, 2 pm (CET).

administered_by.quote: Once the IKI Office at Zukunft - Umwelt - Gesellschaft gGmbH (ZUG) has reviewed the detailed project proposal, a final decision will be made as to funding/project commissioning.

applicant_types.quote: Non-governmental organisations; Universities and research institutions; International intergovernmental organisations and institutions such as development banks; United Nations organisations and programmes; Implementing organisations of the Federal Republic of Germany; Commercial enterprises.

geography.quote: The IKI supports solution strategies in developing and emerging countries that seek to achieve sustainable change.

access.quote: In the first phase (outline phase), interested implementing organisations are invited to submit project outlines within the framework of an ideas competition.

window.quote: How often is funding provided? Annual selection procedure planned.

amount.quote: Depending on the thematic or country priority, IKI funding per project may range between 5 and 20 million euros.

reporting.quote: The technical report consists of information on the accomplished project results, IKI standard indicators and IKI safeguards.
